# Feature: PRD MVP Integrity Gaps

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-09-13 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Roadmap: PRD-MVP (Stufe A) — Close release-blocking integrity gaps: Hidden analysis results, pending analysis timing, role-scoped advisor tools, commit idempotency, offline cloud drafts, and deterministic/AuthZ test gates so the product matches PRD FR-002/003/004, NFR-002/006, and FR-014 (Should).

## Preconditions
- Active run exists (local or cloud).
- Scenario catalog is loaded; player read-model does not include unlocked analysis result bodies.
- Cloud mutations require authenticated owner context.
- Simulation Core remains sole authority for world-state mutation.

## Happy Path
- [x] Requesting an analysis creates a **pending** item with visible duration / available day; result body is not shown yet.
- [x] Advancing time to/past the available day completes the analysis once, appends ledger information, and only then exposes result text in the player view.
- [x] Public scenario/analysis catalog used by UI has no `resultBody` / `resultTitle`; those fields are revealed only via engine unlock.
- [x] Advisor answers are produced from **role-allowed read-only tools** (metrics / completed analyses / ledger summary) — not from locked analysis content.
- [x] Commit with the same `idempotencyKey` returns the same run revision without double-applying effects (local + cloud).
- [x] Cloud mode offline: draft (text/rationale/proposal) persists locally; Commit is disabled until online; local demo remains fully playable offline.
- [x] Vitest gates: determinism fixture (same seed → same metrics) and AuthZ deny for foreign run (server test or domain equivalent) pass under `npm run checks`.

## Edge Cases
- [x] Re-requesting an already pending or completed analysis is a no-op.
- [x] Unknown analysisId is rejected.
- [x] Duplicate commit (same idempotency key) does not mutate twice; conflicting revision still returns 409.
- [x] Advisor tool denied for role returns a safe refusal string; never locked analysis text.
- [x] Offline cloud: opening the app restores draft; going online enables commit without losing text.

## Regression
- [x] Local demo core loop (create → analyze → interpret → commit → advance) still works.
- [x] Scenario picker / company marks / covers unchanged.
- [ ] Cloud register/login still works when API is up.

## Assumptions
- Local demo may still ship result strings inside the JS bundle for the engine, but the **player read-model and UI** never surface them before unlock (DevTools spoiler of module source accepted for local-only).
- Pending analyses consume calendar time via `advanceTime` (request schedules; advancing resolves) — requesting does not instantly unlock.

## Security Coverage
- F-02: Freitext / advisor answers rendered as text; tool outputs schema-bounded.
- F-03/F-05: No secrets in client; offline draft stores only player text + proposal, not tokens beyond existing session.
- B-02/B-03: Cloud run mutations remain owner-scoped; AuthZ test covers foreign run deny.
- B-08: Unknown game/AI ops rejected by Zod.
- B-09: Owner from JWT, never from body.
- P-05: Existing AI rate limits retained.
- Out of scope: F-01 HTTPS (infra), B-04 SQL (parameterized already), P-01 audit (no dep change for secrets).
